title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE NATIONAL HERITAGE PRESERVATION FUND ACT
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE NATIONAL HERITAGE PRESERVATION FUND ACT

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters mandated by the National Heritage Preservation Fund Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof. <Amended on May 7, 2024>

Article 2 (Creation of National Heritage Preservation Fund) "Revenues prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 4(1)6 of the National Heritage Preservation Fund Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means any of the following: <Amended on May 7, 2024>
  1. Money transferred from other funds;
  2. Other revenues recognized by the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service.

Article 3 (Procedures for Collection of Payments) (1) The State and local governments that collect admission fees for designated cultural heritage or natural monuments, etc. under Article 4(2) of the Act shall determine the amount payable based on the admission fees collected by the end of each month, and contribute the determined amount to the National Heritage Preservation Fund (hereinafter referred to as the "Fund") under Article 3 of the Act by the 10th day of the following month. <Amended on May 7, 2024>
  (2) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service may subsidize the State and local governments paying the contributions under paragraph (1) to cover the expenses incurred in performing duties. <Amended on May 7, 2024>
  (3) The State and local governments that collect admission fees for the designated cultural heritages, natural monuments, etc. under Article 4(2) of the Act shall keep and manage basic data for 5 years, such as the receipts of collection of admission fees, a statement of collection, and a collection passbook necessary for calculating the contributions. <Amended on May 7, 2024>

Article 4 (Purpose of Fund) "Projects or activities prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 9 of Article 5 of the Act means any of the following projects or activities: <Amended on Dec. 5, 2017; Sep. 14, 2021; May. 7, 2024>
  1. Deleted; <Sep. 14, 2021>
  2. Deleted; <Dec. 5, 2017>
  3. Support for conservation and education of national heritage;
  4. Academic research and study on national heritage;
  5. Collection, management and operation of the Fund.

Article 5 (Management and operation of Fund) (1) Administrative affairs on the management and operation of the Fund that may be entrusted under Article 6(2) of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended on May. 7, 2024>
  1. Accounting affairs on the management and operation of the Fund;
  2. Affairs on the receipt and management of Fund contributions under subparagraph 4 of Article 4 of the Act;
  3. Affairs on the operation of the surplus funds of the Fund;
  4. Other affairs relating to the management and operation of the Fund, as prescribed by the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service.
  (2) A person who is entrusted with affairs on the management and operation of the Fund under paragraph (1) shall formulate a plan for the operation of the Fund for the following year and submit it to the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service by May 31 of each year. <Amended on May 7, 2024>
  (3) A person entrusted with affairs on the management and operation of the Fund under paragraph (1) shall submit a report on the settlement of accounts of the Fund to the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service by February 10 of the following year. <Amended on May. 7, 2024>
  (4) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service may subsidize a person entrusted with affairs on the management and operation of the Fund under paragraph (1) to cover expenses incurred in performing the affairs. <Amended on May. 7, 2024>
  (5) Except as otherwise provided for in this Decree and other national finance statutes and regulations, matters necessary for the management and operation of the Fund shall be prescribed by the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service. <Amended on May 7, 2024>

Article 6 (Operation of surplus funds of Fund) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service may operate the surplus funds of the Fund by the following methods: <Amended Nov. 15, 2010; May 7, 2024>
  1. Deposits in banks under the Banking Act, financial institutions under other Acts, and postal authorities under the Postal Savings and Insurance Act;
  2. Purchase of securities under Article 4 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act;
  3. Deposits in a public fund management fund in accordance with the Public Capital Management Fund Act;
  4. Purchase of other financial instruments.

Article 7 (Composition and operation of National Heritage Preservation Fund Deliberative Committee) (1) The National Heritage Preservation Fund Deliberative Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Deliberative Committee") under Article 7 of the Act shall be composed of not more than 10 members, including 1 chairperson. <Amended on May 7, 2024>
  (2) The Deputy Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall serve as the chairperson of the Deliberative Committee, and the committee members shall be commissioned or appointed by the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service from among the following persons: <Amended on May 7, 2024>
  1. A public official in charge of the Fund affairs, who belongs to the Senior Executive Service of the Korea Heritage Service;
  2. A person recognized as having extensive expertise and experience in the management and operation of the Fund;
  3. A person recognized as having abundant expertise and experience in the conservation, management, and utilization of national heritage.
  (3) The term of office of the committee members referred to in paragraph (2)2 and 3 shall be 2 years.

Article 7-2 (Dismissal and decommission of committee members) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service may dismiss or decommission a committee member referred to in each subparagraph of Article 7(2), if he or she falls under any of the following cases: <Amended on May 7, 2024>
  1. If a member becomes unable to perform his or her duties due to a mental or physical incapacity;
  2. If a member is found to have engaged in any misconduct in connection with his or her duties;
  3. If a member is deemed unfit to serve as a committee member due to neglect of duties, loss of dignity, or any other reasons;
  4. If a member voluntarily admits that it is difficult to perform his or her duties.

Article 8 (Duties of chairperson) (1) The chairperson shall represent the Committee and exercise overall control over its affairs.
  (2) If the chairperson cannot perform his or her duties for unavoidable reasons, a committee member designated by the chairperson shall perform the duties on his or her behalf.

Article 9 (Meetings) (1) The chairperson shall convene and preside over the meetings of the Committee.
  (2) A majority of incumbent members shall constitute a quorum for the meeting and its resolutions shall be passed with the consent of the majority of the members present.

Article 10 (Administrative secretary) (1) The Deliberative Committee shall have 1 executive secretary designated by the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service from among public officials belonging to the Korea Heritage Service. <Amended on May. 7, 2024>
  (2) The administrative secretary shall handle the administrative affairs of the Deliberative Committee under the order of the chairperson.

Article 11 (Allowances) Allowances may be paid to the Committee members who attend the meetings of the Deliberative Committee within budgetary limits; provided, this shall not apply where a committee member who is a public official attends the meetings in direct connection with the affairs under his or her jurisdiction.

Article 12 (Accounting agency of Fund) If the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service appoints the Fund revenue collection officer, the Fund financial officer, the Fund expenditure officer, and the Fund receipts and disbursements official under Article 10 of the Act, he or she shall notify the Chair of Board of Audit and Inspection, the Minister of Planning and Budget, and the Governor of the Bank of Korea. <Amended on May 7, 2024; Dec. 30, 2025>

Article 13 (Fund account) If the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service has established an account of the Fund in the Bank of Korea under Article 11 of the Act, he or she shall divide it into a revenue account and an expenditure account. <Amended on May. 7, 2024>

Article 14 (Receipt of Fund) If financial resources under Article 4(1) of the Act are transferred to the account of the Fund, a person who has received such financial resources shall send the payment slip without delay to the Fund revenue collection officer.

Article 15 (Allocation of Expenditure Ceiling of Fund)
(1) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall allocate an expenditure ceiling to the fund financial officer in accordance with the monthly revenue and expenditure plan under Article 68 (2) of the National Finance Act. <Amended on May 7, 2024>
(2) When allocating an expenditure ceiling under paragraph (1), the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall notify the Minister of Planning and Budget and the Bank of Korea. <Amended on May 7, 2024; Dec. 30, 2025>
(3) The fund financial officer shall not exceed the expenditure ceiling allocated under paragraph (1) when making expenditure commitments.

Article 16 (Keeping of Books)
(1) The fund revenue collection officer and the fund financial officer shall prepare and keep a general fund ledger, a fund expenditure commitment ledger, and a fund collection ledger, and record general matters concerning the Fund's revenue and expenditure and matters concerning expenditure commitments.
(2) The fund receipts and disbursements official shall prepare and keep a fund receipts and disbursements book and record the status of receipts and disbursements.
